in_marathi.name: Upen
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Morning
in_marathi.long_meaning: Upen हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Upen is the name of the sun god Surya, who is the lord of the morning sky. He is the god of light, energy, and life, and is often depicted riding a chariot drawn by seven horses.

in_bengali.name: Upen
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Morning
in_bengali.long_meaning: Upen একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। In Hindu mythology, Upen is the name of the sun god Surya, who is the lord of the morning sky. He is the god of light, energy, and life, and is often depicted riding a chariot drawn by seven horses.
